title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - LinesideDistanceIndication
description:
Lineside indications of distance (era:LinesideDistanceIndication's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Frequency, appearance and positioning of a sign indicating distance as reference post. Two types of signs are normally available: kilometre post and hectometre post.
- A kilometre post is a lineside sign indicating the distance from a specific point, usually being the starting point of the railway line.
- A hectometre post is a lineside sign indicating a relative distance.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LinesideDistanceIndication'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

linesideDistanceIndicationAppearance.description: Property. Indication of types of appearance of track lineside distance indications. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Lineside distance indication appearance' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/lineside-distance-indication-appearance/LinesideDistanceIndicationAppearance), 4 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

linesideDistanceIndicationFrequency.description: Property. Frequency of track lineside distance indications.

linesideDistanceIndicationPositioning.description: Property. Indication of the side along the track where the lineside indication is positioned (left or right, or both sides). Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Lineside distance indication positioning' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/lineside-distance-indication-positioning/LinesideDistanceIndicationPositioning), 3 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.
